description: A Track and Trace (TT) event where objects or processes are grouped.

actionCode.description: The code specifying the action for this TT aggregation event.

businessStepCode.description: The code specifying the business step for this TT aggregation event.

childObjectInstanceId.description: An instance identifier for a child object of this TT aggregation event.

childQuantitySpecifiedEventElement.description: A quantity event element specified for a child of this TT aggregation event.

destinationRelatedParty.description: A destination related party for this TT aggregation event.

dispositionCode.description: The code specifying the disposition related to this TT aggregation event.

identifier.description: The identifier for this TT aggregation event.

occurrenceDateTime.description: The date, time, date time, or other date time value at which this TT aggregation event occurred.

parentObjectId.description: The identifier of the parent object for this TT aggregation event.

readPointRelatedLocation.description: The read point related location of this TT aggregation event.

recordedDateTime.description: The date, time, date time, or other date time value at which this TT aggregation event was recorded.

relatedCertification.description: A certification related to this TT aggregation event.

relatedTTLocation.description: The location related to this TT aggregation event.

sourceRelatedParty.description: A source related party for this TT aggregation event.

specifiedError.description: A declared error specified for this TT aggregation event.

specifiedTradeTransaction.description: A trade transaction specified for this TT aggregation event.
